title: AI, Technology Revolutions, And Organization Change
displayTitle: 王煜全 x 易论AI：AI、技术革命与组织变化
speaker: 王煜全
sourceStatus: Captured from founder note; exact video URL pending verification.
oneSentence: AI改变的不是工具，而是组织。
summary: A long-form interview captured as the first Bryn OS cognitive asset. The useful layer is not prompt technique, but the deeper pattern: real technology revolutions can coexist with bubbles, behavior digitization creates intelligence infrastructure, and AI may change the basic organization form of knowledge work.
takeaways: 技术革命是真的，但资本市场仍可能产生泡沫。
移动互联网真正完成的是人的行为数字化，而不只是随时上网。
AI的深层影响是组织结构变化：一个人 + 多个Agent + 长期记忆。
mentalModels: Technology truth and bubble risk can coexist.
Organization is the real interface of AI-native work.
xingchenxiImpact: Do not build only AI tools. Build AI-native operating capacity: one researcher, many agents, durable memory, and repeatable workflows.
